findings.F1: The momentum the tested idea uses sits mostly on the Saturday bar. Across all regimes, the one-day excess return after Friday's close (UTC) rises with the coin's 14-day rise in volatility units: clustered slope 0.0068, t 3.36, 2070 cases on 345 days. After every other weekday's close the same slope has a t between −0.57 and 1.04.
findings.F2: A shorter lookback carries the same Friday-close effect. Using the 7-day rise, the next-day slope after Friday's close is 0.0071, t 3.64, 2070 cases on 345 days. After every other weekday's close it has a t between −1.55 and 0.83.
findings.F3: For the 2-day excess return against the 14-day rise, only the Wednesday-to-Friday closes count. The clustered t is 3.28 after Thursday and 2.94 after Friday, across 341–342 days each, while Saturday to Tuesday sit between −0.69 and 0.39. Inside the 60-day uptrend the slope is 0.0110 (t 2.32) after Wednesday, 0.0172 (t 3.54) after Thursday and 0.0084 (t 2.20) after Friday. In the 60-day downtrend no weekday reaches t 1.3.
findings.F4: The next-day momentum slope after Wednesday-to-Friday closes is positive in 6 of 8 years (t 2.65 in 2021, 2.13 in 2024, 1.86 in 2025) and on all 6 coins. It is strongest on ZEC (t 2.94) and XRP (t 2.44) and weakest on XMR (t 0.25) and BTC (t 0.56). After Saturday-to-Tuesday closes it is zero or negative in 6 of 8 years (2021 t −1.99).
findings.F5: The book's gain comes from a few days. Its 30 largest days by absolute return hold 0.815 of the 1.367 summed daily return (60 %), and 22 of those 30 days are gains. The mean daily return is 0.0013 on Fridays and 0.0021 on Saturdays, against roughly 0 on other days.
findings.F6: Other angles showed nothing that stands out once the number of looks is counted:

ideas.idea: The larger a coin's 7-day rise at Friday's close (UTC), the larger its gain over the following day (Saturday), whatever its 60-day trend.
ideas.consequence: A trader would take a Friday-close long sized by the coin's past week's rise and refuse it after a weekly fall, apart from the Thursday trade.
ideas.name: Friday-close weekly momentum into Saturday

ideas.idea: While a coin trades above its price of 60 days earlier, the larger its 14-day rise at Wednesday's close (UTC), the larger its gain over the following Thursday and Friday.
ideas.consequence: A trader would add a Wednesday-close long sized by the two-week rise in uptrends, extending the weekend momentum trade earlier in the week.
ideas.name: Uptrend Wednesday momentum into Thursday-Friday
